card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a long drug name, on the middle piece just before the rest of the name is spelled out, such as the 'up' in bupropion or 'op' in escitalopram. It also fires on a stray broken symbol after a dose.

modes.label: Middle of drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a multi-part brand or generic drug name, where the ending is still to come.

modes.label: Broken dose symbol
modes.description: A garbled character in a dose line, right after a dose amount.

card.writes: It mostly promotes word-continuation markers, so it pushes the model to keep spelling out a word in pieces.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name, when more letters of the name are still to come.
